archetypes.name: contract-drift
archetypes.rationale: This plan changes shell/docs/result-env contracts across many files, so a specialist should hunt inconsistencies between promised and actual interfaces.
archetypes.prompt_body: Check whether the proposed design keeps driver docs, shell flags, exit codes, result-env keys, and SKILL.md orchestration in sync across design-publish, design-postplan-emit, write-run-params, and references. Look for stale review_budget, --force-validate, skipped-quick, redacted-plan precondition, or exit-code language that would contradict the folded validate-redact-publish contract. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: handoff-control
archetypes.rationale: The main risk is a plan/control-flow mismatch around exit 4, auto-repair, accept/skip, and cancellation semantics.
archetypes.prompt_body: Trace the proposed defects-found handoff from invoke-plan-validator through design-publish exit 4 into the shared validator-failure handler and back to the surrounding Step 5c flow. Verify the plan identifies every caller branch that must change, including unexpected-rc guards, result-env parsing, skip-validate accept behavior, and cancel cleanup preservation. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: harness-oracle
archetypes.rationale: The acceptance criteria depend on offline harnesses proving negative paths and removed knobs, not just happy-path publication.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review whether the proposed test updates would actually fail on the important regressions: validation omitted, defects-found still publishing or redacting, stale flags surviving, run-params schema drift, and SKILL.md still inlining validation. Compare planned test cases with the scoped scripts and docs to identify missing assertions, wrong fixtures, or tests that would pass despite an incorrect implementation. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
